title: March demanding presidential resignation and release of uprising detainees
location: Santiago, Los Héroes to La Moneda
threshold_50_evidence: No simultaneous attendee estimate in the opened article; arrests and multiple locations do not establish 50-person threshold.

start_date.summary: Article dated and describes event on 10 December.

location.summary: March from Los Héroes to La Moneda, Santiago.

demands.summary: Presidential resignation and release/indulto of detained people described by organizers as political prisoners.

protester_violence.summary: Barricades and confrontations in city timeline; acts cannot be assigned to all marchers.

state_response.summary: Water cannon/tear gas and seven arrests reported in article.

notes: Cooperativa reports march calling for Piñera resignation and release/indulto of people detained since the uprising. Nearby morning/afternoon groups are not merged without verified linkage.
open_questions: Is there permitted local turnout evidence?
Organizer identity and distinct boundaries among simultaneous groups?

title: Separate morning/nearby mobilization reported on 10 December
location: Santiago, Metro Universidad de Chile / Los Héroes area
threshold_50_evidence: No crowd estimate for the separately described group; threshold unresolved.

start_date.summary: The article reports same-day mobilizations on 10 December.

location.summary: One gathering near Metro Universidad de Chile and another at Los Héroes; exact boundaries unclear.

demands.summary: Same-day article attributes resignation/release demands to the mobilizations generally; assignment to this distinct group remains uncertain.

state_response.summary: Article gives citywide response; assignment to this group uncertain.

notes: S001 separately notes two groups at the same time and says authorities could not establish whether the morning and afternoon mobilizations were connected. Treat as a distinct provisional record; not merged into E001.
open_questions: Are the groups the same event or different gatherings?
Which demands and response apply to this group?

title: Friday protest near La Moneda for release of uprising detainees
location: Santiago, La Moneda / Cerro Santa Lucía / central Alameda
organizer: Unknown; S004 says last-year protest was called, no common organizer link documented
threshold_50_evidence: S002 provides qualitative size language but no count; S004 reports arrests only. Threshold remains unverified.

start_date.summary: S002 dates event Friday 18 December; S004 published 19 Dec and says arrests occurred yesterday.

location.summary: La Moneda/Cerro Santa Lucía/Alameda area (S002); Alameda with Ahumada (S004), possible overlap only.

demands.summary: Release of people imprisoned since the social uprising.

participants.summary: Neither source provides attendee count; arrest number is not attendance.

protester_violence.summary: Source attributes throwing objects/Molotovs to hooded individuals; not generalized to all participants.

state_response.summary: Police dispersal/incendiary-incident arrests reported; S004 attributes numbers to police.

notes: S002 reports people assembling on a Friday to demand release of detainees from the uprising; hooded individuals threw objects/incendiaries at police, not attributable to all attendees. S004 is a police-sourced year-end tally for the same date/central area with 52 Santiago arrests; exact overlap with S002 is unresolved and no attendee count is inferred.
open_questions: Does S004 concern the same assembly as S002?
Can a local count establish the crowd-size threshold?
